instruction.en: Join the sports words to their meanings

pairs.right: a metal prize for the winner
a cup given to the winner
the person who makes sure the rules are followed
a big ground with seats for watching sports
a group of players who play together

steps.question: How many rings are there on the Olympic flag?

questionMeaning.hi: ओलंपिक झंडे पर कितने छल्ले हैं?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Olympic jhande par kitne chhalle hain?

steps.modelAnswer: The Olympic flag has five rings. They stand for five parts of the world.

modelMeaning.hi: ओलंपिक झंडे पर पाँच छल्ले हैं। ये दुनिया के पाँच हिस्सों के लिए हैं।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Olympic jhande par paanch chhalle hain. Yeh duniya ke paanch hisson ke liye hain.

steps.question: Which Indian won a gold medal in javelin throw at the Tokyo Olympics?

questionMeaning.hi: टोक्यो ओलंपिक में भाला फेंक का स्वर्ण पदक किस भारतीय ने जीता?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Tokyo Olympic mein bhaala phenk ka swarn padak kis Bhaarateeya ne jeeta?

steps.modelAnswer: Neeraj Chopra won a gold medal in javelin throw at the Tokyo Olympics.

modelMeaning.hi: नीरज चोपड़ा ने टोक्यो ओलंपिक में भाला फेंक का स्वर्ण पदक जीता।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Neeraj Chopra ne Tokyo Olympic mein bhaala phenk ka swarn padak jeeta.

steps.question: What made Bobby Pearce a true champion?

questionMeaning.hi: बॉबी पियर्स को सच्चा चैंपियन क्या बनाता है?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Bobby Pearce ko sachcha champion kya banaata hai?

options: He was kind to the ducklings and still won.
steps.answer: He was kind to the ducklings and still won.
steps.modelAnswer: Bobby was a true champion because he was kind and still won the race.

modelMeaning.hi: बॉबी सच्चा चैंपियन था क्योंकि वह दयालु था और फिर भी रेस जीता।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Bobby sachcha champion tha kyonki woh dayaalu tha aur phir bhi race jeeta.

steps.sentence: Our school team won a big ___ at the sports meet.

meaning.hi: हमारी स्कूल टीम ने खेल प्रतियोगिता में एक बड़ी ट्रॉफ़ी जीती।
meaning.hinglish: Hamari school team ne khel pratiyogita mein ek badi trophy jeeti.
